outfit.name: 英伦学院风粗花呢短外套与格纹裙
outfit.prose: A cropped cream bouclé tweed collegiate jacket with dark horn buttons, layered over an ice-blue striped point-collar Oxford shirt and a charcoal micro pleated schoolgirl skirt. Paired with ribbed black knee-high socks, a slim burgundy leather thigh band, and chunky lug-sole platform penny loafers.
